title: Sandbox backend selection and provider class resolution
answers: How is the sandbox backend (modal vs hogland) chosen?
How does cleanup pick the sandbox class?
body:
- Per-run backend: `temporal/process_task/activities/get_task_processing_context.py:_resolve_sandbox_backend` returns "modal" or "hogland"; fails closed to modal. `state["sandbox_backend"]=="modal"` override always wins; hogland requires HOGLAND_API_URL+token, non-EU, no custom image, no Pi runtime, default template; a hogland override pins, else `tasks-hogland-sandbox` flag decides. Stored in `TaskProcessingContext.sandbox_backend`.
- Class: `logic/services/sandbox.py:get_sandbox_class_for_run_backend` diverts only for hogland, else `get_sandbox_class()` reads settings `SANDBOX_PROVIDER` (docker, MODAL_DOCKER, MODAL_EVALS, hogland only in DEBUG/TEST, default Modal).
- `get_sandbox_class_for_sandbox_id`: id prefix `box-` → hogland, else default; used by cleanup and reaper.
- Impls: `logic/services/{modal,docker,hogland}_sandbox.py`.
- Reporting: `provision_sandbox.py` calls `sandbox_class.create`; `temporal/metrics.py:modal_sandbox_backend_label` gives v1/v2 (MODAL_SANDBOX_V2); `models.py:SandboxSession.sandbox_backend` is NULL for Modal.
